reuse.why: Threads holidays through the existing getDateWithSkippedWeekend, getNextDate and getAdjustedOccurrence paths and adds one shared isNonWorkingDay predicate that all of them use.

duplication.why: No new copied logic, but because the tree already splits daily skipping between getNextDate and app.ts's getAdjustedOccurrence, the diff has to make parallel edits in both, plus look-ahead padding heuristics in two places.

placement.why: The non-working-day rule and the moving loop sit in shared/schedules.ts; callers only pass the holidays from their own config.

scope.why: Limited to holiday plumbing, the shared predicate, the type, tests and a release note.

maintainability.why: Changing what counts as a holiday now touches only isNonWorkingDay, though each caller still passes holidays by hand and the two padding formulas could drift.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All weekend/holiday decisions go through isNonWorkingDay and getDateWithSkippedWeekend.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic introduced; the existing daily-skip split is only extended in parallel.

one_place.where: isNonWorkingDay in shared/schedules.ts defines a holiday as a non-working day for getDateWithSkippedWeekend, getNextDate's daily skip and app.ts's getAdjustedOccurrence.
